_description: POST /api/agents/{agentName}/invoke — Continues an existing conversation by passing the 'responseId' from a previous response as 'previousResponseId'. Replace {agentName} in the URL.
_notes: Replace 'previousResponseId' with the 'responseId' returned from the previous invoke call.
Each response returns a new 'responseId' — always use the latest one for continuation.
Conversation context is maintained server-side by the Foundry Responses API.

_example_response.assistantMessage: Thank you, John! I found your order #12345 associated with john.doe@example.com. It appears there was a delay at the carrier. The new estimated delivery date is tomorrow by 6 PM. Would you like me to send you a tracking link?
